regions.full_page: From "City of God" .... Coronation #608 Handwritten notes. "My daughter, when mortals, having run their the short course of their lives, come to the end at which God expects them to merit eternal life, then will they also by their own experience, see the finish of all their errors and deceits ....... how "happy, my daugh- ter, is the man, who during the short instant of his life seeks to anticipate the divine science, which he is so soon to possess by experience." # 613 - '14 Most Holy Mary Celebrates Her Im't Conception. "These feasts" (Im. Concept. and Nativity) she began to celebrate at the time - from the time of the Incarnation .... more particularly after the Ascension and most especially the last days of her life. ' 14 On the 8th day of December of each year she celebrated her Immacu- late Conception with a jubilee and gratitude beyond all human under- standing.

regions.full_page: Trip to Baltimre - New York, Glenclyff, Yonkers, Harlem, East N.Y. (Handwritten Notes) July 20, 1940 After Extremely busy day before we left Saturday - via Toledo & Akron for Pittsburgh. Stopped to visit "Head Quarters" in really artistic, beautiful Cathedral of Holy Rosary at first named (Tolado) we were given very interesting explanation - % Ex-minister Ja's A. Smith now a covert (convert) - of exquisit decorations with brief sketch of his own conversion. Took dinner in Akron Ohio In Pittsburgh Pa. in good time but sought St. Peter's for about an hour (at least) before "tricked by Enemy ..... went to bed without supper-save one glass of cocola - no one's fault but my own .... had children's Mass (8:30) ... never spoke better ... Deo Gr. Invited after wards to address public-school children. till voice completely co- lapsed ..... Deo Gr. !! Crossed the Aliganies .. picturesque! Dinner in "Historic Bedford", temperature 112 .... . Three hours in Gettysburg: Very interesting place. Stayed at Retreat Mt. Hope-Saturday, Sunday and Monday.
